title: Datasets of an inherited form or data module
summary: repo read-dfm follows link sources, lookups and grid datasets, and inherited datasets, into the ancestor DFM, and finds modules of used units in the project
intro: Read this when repo read-dfm reports a memory table or a lookup as unresolved although its source is a dataset of an inherited data module. drag-lint finds the ancestor class in the unit beside the DFM and reads the one DFM of the same folder that has it, also for inherited datasets; a module of a used unit elsewhere in the project folder is found too. What it cannot follow is a warning that names the reason; nothing is picked. AttachTable(X.Table) links to dataset X.

questions.ask: Why is a memory table copied from a dataset of an inherited data module unresolved, and which table does it hold?
Which ancestor DFM did repo read-dfm read a dataset from, and why was an ancestor not followed?
